text:
Four dyes, P, Q, R and S, are analysed using chromatography.
Water is the solvent.
The chromatogram produced is shown.
solvent front
baseline

Q
R

Which statement about the dyes is correct?
A
All four dyes are impure.
B
The four dyes contain a total of eight different substances.
C
Dye R is a mixture of dye P and dye Q.
D
Dye S is a mixture of dye Q and one other substance.

options.label: B
options.text: The four dyes contain a total of eight different substances.

options.label: C
options.text: Dye R is a mixture of dye P and dye Q.

options.label: D
options.text: Dye S is a mixture of dye Q and one other substance.
